summary: BBVA filed a 6-K announcing an issuance of €1,000,000,000 of preferred securities contingently convertible into newly issued ordinary shares, excluding pre-emptive subscription rights. Payment is discretionary and distributions accrue at 6.500% annually from 18 November 2026 to 18 May 2034, then reset at the 5-year Mid-Swap Rate plus 333.4 bp. Once fully paid, securities are expected to qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital. A director's report and independent expert/auditor report were issued. Listing is sought on Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market; closing expected 18 November 2026. Watch conversion triggers and capital-ratio impact.
